text: did u say there were keybindings? none of them work if so or i have no idea what htey are since they still are not in the tool tips
resolution: Fixed the two real gaps behind 'none of them work / not in tooltips': (1) the keys a user reaches for had none bound, and (2) no tooltip showed a key. Verified the typing gate wasn't the culprit (focused_input_id defaults to -1, so the existing 4 keys do fire). Bound modes 1-6 and transform tools G/R/S through the contract (same guards as their buttons), added chordHintFor() and prefixed every keyed tooltip (mode tabs, transform tools, reframe, undo/redo) with the LIVE chord so it's truthful and updates on rebind. New keys appear in the Hotkeys panel and are rebindable. controls.test.ts updated to free-key fixtures (the old test picked 'g', now a real binding) — 11/11 pass via esbuild+v8cli; built green + self-shot. Needs live confirmation that the keys fire (1-6, G/R/S, F, Esc, Ctrl+A, Del) and the tooltips show them. Mesh ops (extrude/flip/etc.) intentionally still unbound — wire next if wanted. SHA ea4fd1f5a.
